Calculate shared variant statistics

Source: R/bridge.R
calcSharedVariants.Rd

Counts, for one transmission pair, the variant sites present in both hosts, in the donor alone and in the recipient alone, using the calls that passed QC.

Usage

calcSharedVariants(whe, pairId, minDepth = NULL)

Arguments

whe

A WithinHostExperiment.

pairId

Character. Which pair to analyse.

minDepth

Integer. The recipient depth at or above which an absent donor variant counts as absent at adequate depth. Defaults to the strictest minDepth of the filters applied with flagISNV, or to 100 when none was applied.

Value

A named list: n_donor_only (the four groups below added together), n_donor_only_adequate_depth, n_donor_only_low_depth, n_donor_only_unknown_depth, n_donor_only_recipient_failed_qc, n_recipient_only, n_shared, n_total, sharing_rate (shared sites over all sites) and min_depth, the threshold used.

Details

A host carries a variant at a site when its frequency there is known and above 0, as in exportPairFrequencies; a recorded frequency of 0 is a site that was assessed and found without the variant.

A donor variant absent from the recipient means one thing when the recipient was sequenced deeply enough at that site to have shown it, and another when it was not. The donor-only count is therefore split by the recipient's read depth at the site, from the totalDepth assay: n_donor_only_adequate_depth where that depth is at least minDepth, n_donor_only_low_depth where it is lower, and n_donor_only_unknown_depth where it is missing. Depth is missing at every site the recipient's caller did not report when the object was read from VCF files, which list only the sites with a call, so with such input most donor-only sites fall in the last group; a depth matrix from a coverage file, or a table listing every assessed site with its depth and a frequency of 0 where the recipient had no alternative reads (readWithinHostTable with format = "generic" and aaf = 0), is needed to tell the first two apart. A fourth group, n_donor_only_recipient_failed_qc, holds the sites where the recipient did make a call, at a frequency above 0, but QC removed it, for example a call above maxFreq in a recipient where the variant rose towards fixation: such a site is not absent, so it is kept out of the three depth groups. Only a donor-only site at adequate depth is evidence of loss in transmission.

Examples

vcf1 <- system.file("extdata", "test_donor.vcf",
    package = "WithinHostExperiment")
vcf2 <- system.file("extdata", "test_recipient.vcf",
    package = "WithinHostExperiment")
whe <- readWithinHost(c(vcf1, vcf2),
    colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(
        sample_id = c("donor", "recipient"),
        role = c("donor", "recipient"),
        pair_id = c("p1", "p1")),
    caller = "ivar")
calcSharedVariants(whe, pairId = "p1")
#> $n_donor_only
#> [1] 10
#> 
#> $n_donor_only_adequate_depth
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $n_donor_only_low_depth
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $n_donor_only_unknown_depth
#> [1] 10
#> 
#> $n_donor_only_recipient_failed_qc
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $n_recipient_only
#> [1] 5
#> 
#> $n_shared
#> [1] 5
#> 
#> $n_total
#> [1] 20
#> 
#> $sharing_rate
#> [1] 0.25
#> 
#> $min_depth
#> [1] 100
#>
